description: This file implements the cell activation routine for a 5G network, managing configuration updates for cells based on PLMN changes, interacting with DU processors, and handling asynchronous configuration update responses.

classes.name: cell_activation_routine
classes.description: A class responsible for managing cell activation procedures, including configuration updates and PLMN management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main routine executing the cell activation process asynchronously, updating configurations for DU processors.

methods.name: get_plmns_to_activate
methods.description: Determines which PLMNs need to be activated based on the current cell configuration.

methods.name: generate_gnb_cu_configuration_update
methods.description: Generates a configuration update message for the gNB-CU based on deactivated cells and PLMN status.
